title: U.S. History — One Nation Under God: Unit Quiz

questions.question: What was the significance of the Mayflower Compact (1620)?
options: It declared independence from England
It established the principle of self-government by voluntary covenant
It created the first American constitution
It abolished the monarchy in the colonies

questions.question: According to the Declaration of Independence, where do human rights come from?
options: From the government
From the Constitution
From the Creator
From the consent of the majority

questions.question: Which Biblical verse is often cited as the basis for the separation of powers in the U.S. Constitution?
options: Genesis 1:1
Isaiah 33:22
John 3:16
Romans 8:28

questions.question: James Madison argued in Federalist No. 51 that 'ambition must be made to counteract ambition.' This reflects which Biblical doctrine?
options: The sovereignty of God
The goodness of creation
The sinfulness of human nature
The priesthood of all believers

questions.question: What was the primary driving force behind the abolitionist movement?
options: Economic self-interest of Northern industrialists
Christian conviction that slavery violated human dignity
Political rivalry between North and South
European pressure on American policy

questions.question: In his Second Inaugural Address, how did Abraham Lincoln interpret the Civil War?
options: As a political dispute over states' rights
As an economic conflict over tariffs
As God's judgment on the national sin of slavery
As an unavoidable consequence of population growth

questions.question: Which constitutional amendments were passed during Reconstruction to secure the rights of freed slaves?
options: 1st, 2nd, and 3rd Amendments
13th, 14th, and 15th Amendments
19th, 20th, and 21st Amendments
4th, 5th, and 6th Amendments

questions.question: What was the main theological weakness of the Social Gospel movement?
options: It ignored the Old Testament
It focused on social transformation at the expense of personal salvation
It rejected all government involvement in society
It supported slavery

questions.question: Why did President Reagan call the Soviet Union an 'evil empire'?
options: Because it was a military threat to the United States
Because it was an atheistic system that denied God, suppressed freedom, and enslaved nations
Because it competed with America economically
Because it had a larger army

questions.question: John Adams said the Constitution was 'made only for a moral and religious people.' What did he mean?
options: Only church members should be allowed to vote
The Constitution requires a state religion to function
Free government depends on the virtue and self-discipline that come from faith
The Constitution is a religious document
